name: bed-nether-player-near
comment: WP-4.8. tick/bed-nether with the player (id 0) standing next to the bed, at (0.5, 61, 2.5), 1.5 blocks west of it, as a player who clicks a bed always is. BlockBed.blockActivated in the nether removes both halves and runs World.newExplosion(null, x + 0.5F, y + 0.5F, z + 0.5F, 5.0F, true) (BlockBed.java:30-46, World.java:1522-1528); the explosion's entity scan (Explosion.java:77-105) finds the activating player, which the port holds out of its slot during the click: it must be tested where the scan reaches it (passed in hand, as EntityTNTPrimed passes itself). The player is pushed away and killed (health -28 at t=1, deathTime counting). Before WP-4.8 the port skipped it (recorded the R5 taken-out-entity gap) and the player stood unhurt. entity_state of the player and rng_state every tick.
